steps.text: Stage 1 (this build if you used -Pcommunity): ACME pins Spring Framework 5.3.18 from community packages. The demo catalog marks representative Spring CVEs as VULNERABLE.
steps.visual:
Build: ./mvnw -Pcommunity package
Spring = 5.3.18
Jackson / Commons Text pins unchanged
CVE table = story prop (not a scanner)

steps.text: Wire Nexus once: put fake Lightwell packages in lightwell-java-remediated and search that repo first in maven-public. Optionally publish the app JAR to maven-releases.
steps.visual:
maven-public members (order):
  1. lightwell-java-remediated
  2. maven-central (and other stock members)

upload-mock-to-nexus.sh → Lightwell hosted

steps.text: Stage 2: rebuild with the lightwell profile. Only the Spring version becomes 5.3.18.rhlw-00010. Spring CVE rows flip to REMEDIATED; Jackson and Commons Text stay VULNERABLE on purpose.
steps.visual:
./mvnw -Plightwell -s maven/settings-nexus.xml
5.3.18 → 5.3.18.rhlw-00010
Spring CVEs → REMEDIATED
Other pins → still VULNERABLE (surgical)

steps.text: Same order API, same application code. Lightwell entered through Nexus — not a rewrite of ACME Order Hub.
steps.visual:
App code: unchanged
Resolve path: Nexus maven-public
Story: pin forever, remediate the library you choose
